say:2:1720304001:1.text: It's over! Completely over! We're doomed! Tonight's show is finished before it even began!
say:2:1720304001:1.source_cn: 完了，全完了！……这下可怎么办啊！今天的演出要泡汤了！

say:3:1720304002:0.text: And on the biggest festival of the year, of all times. Our host is injured, the prop master is down... This is it. This is the end for my troupe!
say:3:1720304002:0.source_cn: 在这么重要的庆典舞台上开天窗，主持人也伤了，道具师也倒...

say:8:1720304004:1.source_cn: 这位先生，请问是发生什么事了吗？

say:9:1720304005:1.text: Something went wrong while we were setting up the stage. A prop crate fell and struck both the host and the prop master. They've already been rushed off for treatment.
say:9:1720304005:1.source_cn: 刚才搭建布景的时候出了意外，一个道具箱砸了下来，我的主...

say:10:1720304006:1.text: The curtain's about to go up, and I still don't have the people I need to save this show!
say:10:1720304006:1.source_cn: 眼看演出就要开始，我实在是找不到人手来救场了！

say:11:1720304007:1.text: Hey, you two, just in time! Tell me, do you like theater? Ever wanted to be onstage? This might be your chance.
say:11:1720304007:1.source_cn: 二位！你们来得正好！你们对戏剧感兴趣吗？想参与剧目表演...

say:12:1720304008:1.text: Director, take it easy! They were just passing through!
say:12:1720304008:1.source_cn: 导演！你冷静一点！他们只是路过！

say:15:1720304010:1.text: Hello! Why hasn't the show started yet? I came to see King Rolan smash Hypofiends!
say:15:1720304010:1.source_cn: 导演导演！戏剧为什么还不开始呀？我要看罗兰大帝打败魔物！

say:16:1720304011:1.text: Did something happen? I've been looking forward to this show all day...
say:16:1720304011:1.source_cn: 是出什么事了吗？为了看这场表演，我提前期待了好久……

say:17:1720304012:1.text: Alright, alright, I'm doing what I can! But if I can't find help fast... there may not be a show tonight...
say:17:1720304012:1.source_cn: 孩子们，别急，我正在努力想办法……如果实在找不到人来救...

choice_prompt:19:1720304012.text: Alright, alright, I'm doing what I can! But if I can't find help fast... there may not be a show tonight...
choice_prompt:19:1720304012.source_cn: 孩子们，别急，我正在努力想办法……如果实在找不到人来救场，恐怕……恐怕今天只能让大家失望了……

say:20:1720304013:1.text: You'd help us? Really? I need a host and a prop master! I knew it the second I saw you, with your kind eyes and heroic posture. You have the unmistakable air of someone who would never turn away a soul in need!
say:20:1720304013:1.source_cn: 您、您愿意帮忙？！我需要主持人和道具师！看到您的第一眼...

say:22:1720304014:1.text: The host keeps the whole show moving, connects each scene, and keeps the audience engaged. In other words, absolutely essential!

say:25:1720304016:1.text: Well... if you think I can do it, I'll give it a shot!

say:25:1720304016:1.male: Well... if you think I can do it, I'll give it a shot!
say:25:1720304016:1.female: Well... if you think I can do it, I'll give it a shot!

say:26:1720304017:1.text: Elegant, composed, clear voice... yes, yes, the more I look, the more I'm convinced. She's exactly what this stage needs!
say:26:1720304017:1.source_cn: 这位小姐气质优雅，声音清亮……仔细看看，确实是主持人的...

say:27:1720304018:0.text: Props, placements, swaps, scene tricks, surprise effects. The prop master is the hidden genius behind all the things the audience gasps at. Basically, the real magician backstage!

say:35:1720304023:1.source_cn: 没问题！别说免费看剧了，哪怕您想躺在家里看，我都会亲自...

say:38:1720304026:1.text: Right. Yes. Back to the important part!

say:40:1720304027:1.text: Miss Host, here's the script! It has four parts, and the lines aren't too hard. What matters is that you keep the story moving and keep the audience with you.
say:40:1720304027:1.source_cn: 主持人小姐！这是我们戏剧的剧本，总共分为四个部分，台词...

say:41:1720304028:1.source_cn: 好的，这些台词……我记住了。

say:43:1720304030:1.text: And your part is even simpler, sir!
say:43:1720304030:1.male: And your part is even simpler, sir!
say:43:1720304030:1.female: And your part is even simpler, miss!

say:44:1720304031:1.text: Just stay by the side of the stage and watch for my signal. When I cue you, give us the effect we need!
say:44:1720304031:1.source_cn: 您只需要站在舞台侧面，等我示意的时候，帮忙释放一些……...
say:44:1720304031:1.male: Just stay by the side of the stage and watch for my signal. When I cue you, give us the effect we need!

say:45:1720304032:1.text: I'm counting on both of you!

choice:34:0:1.text: Free tickets will do just fine!
choice:34:0:1.source_cn: 以后让我们免费看剧就行
choice:34:0:1.male: Free tickets will do just fine!

choice:34:1:2.female: Just save us seats in the front row.
